description:
You are a compliance officer auditing system configuration files. In the directory /home/user/audit_configs, there are two files: /home/user/audit_configs/server.yaml and /home/user/audit_configs/security.toml.

Your task is to extract the value assigned to key max_connections from both configuration files and write them to a new file named /home/user/audit_configs/max_connections_report.txt.

The output in /home/user/audit_configs/max_connections_report.txt must follow this exact format (including capitalization and punctuation):

Server YAML max_connections: [YAML_VALUE]
Security TOML max_connections: [TOML_VALUE]

Replace [YAML_VALUE] with the integer value from server.yaml, and [TOML_VALUE] with the integer value from security.toml. Each line should end with a newline character.

Do not alter the content of the original YAML or TOML files.
truth:
# Initial file setup:
Create the following directory and files before the task starts:

Directory:
/home/user/audit_configs

Files and contents:

/home/user/audit_configs/server.yaml:
---
port: 8080
host: "127.0.0.1"
max_connections: 250
debug: false

/home/user/audit_configs/security.toml:
[settings]
encryption = true
firewall = "enabled"
max_connections = 150

# Expected output file after successful task completion:

/home/user/audit_configs/max_connections_report.txt:
Server YAML max_connections: 250
Security TOML max_connections: 150

# Permissions:
The agent user should have write access to /home/user/audit_configs/ and all contents.
